factualityMarkers: Use only records in approvedEvidence.records as factual source material.
Every personal, employment, qualification, skill, date, metric, technology
Evidence records with purpose CV may be cited only by /cv contentPaths.
Treat evidenceId as an opaque stable fact identifier.
Never use the job advert alone as evidence that the candidate has a skill
Do not infer motivation, availability, salary expectations, work authorisation
Represent every selected evidence entry at least once in final content
qualityMarkers: Select 8 to 12 unique, job-relevant core skills
Represent PROJECT evidence only in cv.projects
Represent only EMPLOYMENT evidence in cv.workHistory
Do not repeat a normalised line or paragraph
